description: Defines a custom annotation @FieldMatch for validating that two fields in a class have matching values, typically used for password confirmation or email confirmation. Includes annotation metadata and an inner annotation for multiple field matches.

classes.name: FieldMatch
classes.description: Custom validation annotation for matching two fields within a class, with optional multiple pair validation via inner @List annotation.

classes.name: FieldMatch.List
classes.description: Inner annotation allowing multiple FieldMatch annotations on the same element.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Default validation message if fields do not match.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Provides metadata information about validation failure.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the name of the first field to compare.

methods.name: second
methods.description: Returns the name of the second field to compare.
